claim: pDaftar (PDAFTAR MCHJ, Termiz) is broader than recorded in EVID-003: it runs on iOS, Android, web and a Telegram bot, names corner shops as a target, and lists automatic SMS and Telegram reminders, customer debt visibility via link, a shop page with QR code, multi-seller access with action logging, cash book and installment sales. Its site claims 50,000+ Google Play downloads, 5,000+ businesses using it daily and a 4.8 rating. Figures are self-reported. Per-entry customer confirmation and any claim of improved repayment were not found on the page.
